info.description: Reusable orbiting light effect for badges, cards, buttons, containers, etc.

info.description: Universal icon component - supports Lucide icons, emoji, or custom image uploads

customImage.description: Upload custom icon image (SVG, PNG). Overrides lucideName and emoji if iconType is 'custom'

info.description: 💡 Theme Defaults - Light: #16a34a → #84cc16 → #e8f5e9 | Dark: #22c55e → #a3e635 → #f0fdf4. Leave fields EMPTY to use theme colors automatically. Only customize when you need brand-specific or seasonal gradients.

lightModeStart.description: 💡 Default: #16a34a ███ (Theme Primary Green). Leave EMPTY to use theme color. Set custom color only for special campaigns/branding.

lightModeMiddle.description: 💡 Default: #84cc16 ███ (Theme Lime). Leave EMPTY for automatic blend (70% opacity of start color). Customize for unique gradient effects.

lightModeEnd.description: 💡 Default: #e8f5e9 ███ (Light Green Tint). Leave EMPTY for automatic fade (20% opacity of start color). Set for custom gradient finish.

darkModeStart.description: 💡 Default: #22c55e ███ (Theme Primary Light Green). Leave EMPTY to use theme dark mode color. Override for dark mode specific branding.

darkModeMiddle.description: 💡 Default: #a3e635 ███ (Theme Lime Light). Leave EMPTY for automatic blend (70% opacity). Customize for dark mode gradient variety.

darkModeEnd.description: 💡 Default: #f0fdf4 ███ (Very Light Green). Leave EMPTY for automatic fade (20% opacity). Set for dark mode gradient finish customization.
